80	/**
81	 * Abstract filesystem provider. Targets must preserve identity across aliases;
82	 * reads expose regular UTF-8 text or typed errors, listings are stable and
83	 * content-free, and mutations are atomic. Optional guards add stale protection
84	 * without changing the unguarded provider contract.
85	 */
86	export abstract class FileSystem extends Service {

91	  /**

93	   * `undefined` when it does not confine at all — the capability fact the tool
94	   * layer reads to advertise the escalation fields honestly (mirrors
95	   * `ShellExecutor.sandboxMode`). The base class and the bare local backend
96	   * report `undefined`; a sandboxing backend (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-sandbox`)
97	   * overrides it with the deployment default. A session override may make the
98	   * effective mode narrower or wider, so strict escalation widening is checked
99	   * per call rather than encoded in this default-relative fact.
100	   * @returns the configured default mode of a sandboxing backend; `undefined`
101	   *   for a backend that never confines.
102	   */
103	  get sandboxMode(): SandboxMode | undefined {
104	    return undefined
105	  }
106	
107	  /**

111	   *
112	   * @param path - the path to resolve; relative paths resolve against `opts.cwd`.
113	   * @param opts - optional cwd override and cancellation signal.
114	   * @returns the stable target; the same file yields the same `targetKey`.
115	   */
116	  abstract resolve(path: string, opts?: { cwd?: string; signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<FsTarget>
117	
118	  /**

123	   * @param target - the resolved target whose process path is required.

128	  /**

138	    return undefined
139	  }
140	
141	  /**
142	   * Return the canonical `file:` URI for a target in this filesystem's
143	   * execution world. Backends own URI encoding because the host platform may
144	   * differ from the execution platform.
145	   * @param target - the resolved target to encode.
146	   * @returns the target's canonical file URI.
147	   */
148	  abstract fileUrl(target: FsTarget): string
149	
150	  /**
151	   * Test canonical containment without exposing or parsing backend target
152	   * keys. Both targets must come from this provider.
153	   * @param parent - canonical directory target.
154	   * @param child - canonical candidate target.
155	   * @returns true when `child` is `parent` or a descendant of it.
156	   */
157	  abstract contains(parent: FsTarget, child: FsTarget): boolean
158	
159	  /**
160	   * Return target metadata, or `undefined` when the target does not exist.
161	   * @param target - the resolved target to stat.
162	   * @param signal - aborts the metadata round-trip.
163	   * @returns metadata only, never content; undefined for an absent target.
164	   */
165	  abstract stat(target: FsTarget, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<FsInfo | undefined>
166	
167	  /**
168	   * Return path metadata without following the final path component when it is a
169	   * symbolic link. This is intentionally path-shaped, not target-shaped:
170	   * {@link resolve} follows symlinks to produce the stable identity used by
171	   * normal reads/writes, while `lstat` lets a consumer reject the path itself

173	   *
174	   * `opts.cwd` follows {@link resolve}'s cwd rules. `undefined` means the path is
175	   * absent.
176	   * @param path - the path to inspect; relative paths resolve against `opts.cwd`.
177	   * @param opts - `cwd` overrides the backend's default base for relative paths.
178	   * @param signal - aborts the metadata round-trip.
179	   * @returns metadata only, never content; undefined for an absent path.
180	   */
181	  abstract lstat(path: string, opts?: { cwd?: string }, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<FsPathInfo | undefined>
182	
183	  /**
184	   * Read the whole regular text file as a single decoded string.
185	   * @param target - the resolved target to read.
186	   * @param signal - aborts the read.
187	   * @returns the full decoded UTF-8 content.
188	   */
189	  abstract readText(target: FsTarget, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<string>
